GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing start 1.5 Lengths and Settled Down last 6.5 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 5.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Held Ground in Straight # missed the start

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 9 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Up 500m-250m then Hooked Out 4-5 Wide and Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards: Rider reported it was inclined to lay in throughout.] # back/battled fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running from the 500m when close to heels, until the 250m. Approaching the winning post was awkwardly placed near heels. Rdr reported mount was inclined to lay in throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 8 Lengths Two Wide , Hooked Out Four Wide at the 550m and Moved Up to 1 length Four Wide turning, loomed mid-straight but couldn't go past the winner. (Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) FIRST TIME) # Wide last 550m/ok
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 4 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Made Some Ground close to fence in Straight # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 200m, eased when awkwardly placed at heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, ridden forward when it became obvious it would be trapped very wide, took Lead 3 Wide at the 1000m and crossed at the 900m, Held Together in front & led a half length turning, Headed mid-turn and dropped off in Straight # worked hard early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start shifted in and bumped another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, not bustled early & Settled Down 6 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to Turn then Made Ground along rail in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keen early. Near the 600m, shifted in and bumped rail.
Jumped away awkwardly. Inclined to hang inwards in the early stages whilst racing keenly. Raced wide throughout. Laid inwards when placed under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 3 Wide joint Lead settling down, in Two Wide by the 875m, Drifted Back to 1.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Ground in Straight # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure down the running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 2 or 3 lengths and Settled Down 6 Lengths Two Wide , pushed 3 Wide at the 900m, Moved Up to 4 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Dropped Out in straight. (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME) # slow out then Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in bumping another runner on several occasions passing the 1100m. Continued to crowd that runner for some distance until approaching the 700m.Raced wide and without cover for majority of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok settled down better than Mid Field in a very strung out bunch 5 Lengths (1000m), closer Turn , Under Pressure Straight , faded Under Whip jock sat up latter stages (barrier extension off 1st time) # no run on at all
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Contacted winning stalls in the enclosure pre-race & vetted.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 5 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 4 Lengths Two Wide turning, improved only marginally in straight. (Barrier Extension FIRST TIME) # no real excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and shifted in. Near the 300m, obliged to steady when improved onto heels and shifted wider to improve.
